snippet.title: FREE Steam Demo OUT NOW! | Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
snippet.description:
The FREE Steam demo for Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is OUT NOW! 🐱

An idle RPG that keeps adventuring while you work, study, or watch videos.

Build a three-member team, hatch and collect DreamSpirits, and explore a fantasy world — all from a little corner of your desktop.

✨ Try the free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147000/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=demo_launch_20261006&utm_content=horizontal_full

✅ Demo progress carries over to the full game.
📅 Full game launches October 29, 2026.

Enjoyed the demo? Add the game to your Steam wishlist to support this solo-developed adventure!

💬 Join our Discord to share your team, ask questions, or report bugs:
https://discord.gg/UERx2Ztwae

#DaydreamCat #steamdemo  #idlerpg  #desktopgame  #indiegame  #pcgaming
